steps.summary: Off by default. When on, Redoubt asks redoubtbrowser.org at most once a day whether a newer version exists. That site is hosted on GitHub Pages, so GitHub sees your IP address and the time of the request. Not needed if you installed from F-Droid or Accrescent.
